narration: The Krebs cycle, per glucose. Remember, that's two turns of the cycle.
It runs in the mitochondrial matrix. Acetyl-CoA joins oxaloacetate to make citrate.
Quick quiz. What comes out per glucose? The answer: 2 ATP, 6 NADH, 2 FADH2 and 4 CO2.
